Version 1.0.1

- No code or documentation changes detected in this release.
- Functionality, features, and usage remain the same as version 1.0.0.

Initial release of Fiverr Gig Automation.

- Automates creation and management of Fiverr gigs using browser automation (Selenium).
- Sends offers and proposals to buyers based on skill matching.
- Manages your Fiverr inbox with automated, personalized replies.
- Requests reviews from clients after successful gig delivery.
- Tracks and reports daily Fiverr earnings.
- Requires only ChromeDriver, no Fiverr API needed.
